comment: Generated by scripts/emc.py from mods/<port>/emc/policy.json. Explicit values for uncraftable mekanismadditions items and conversions for machine steps ProjectE cannot see; the FAKE|no_emc conversion never resolves, so excluded items get no EMC. Everything else is derived from recipes by ProjectE.

mekanismadditions_additions_plastic_blac.comment: Four HDPE sheets make four plastic blocks. The dye is left out so every color, including dark red and aqua which only the painting machine makes, has the same value.

mekanismadditions_additions_slick_black.comment: The enrichment chamber turns one plastic block into one slick plastic block. That is cheaper than the slimeball craft, so slick plastic takes the enriched cost.

mekanismadditions_additions_transparent_.comment: Eight HDPE sheets make eight transparent plastic blocks. The dye is left out so painting one color into another cannot create EMC.

mekanismadditions_additions_glow_panel_b.comment: Two glow panels take two glass panes, four HDPE sheets and two glowstone dust. The dye is left out so painting a glow panel cannot create EMC.
